name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.0 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 6 visits over 67 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 33 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.8 days starting 2025-12-05, at wavelengths from 0.96 to 4.61 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
